validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE (HIGH): P6727 is line 'three' of Package 8 of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3), a ~USD 18bn / 4,153 km / ~3.15-3.2 bscfd, 56-inch east-west gas megaproject. Package 8 = 'laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-8 to EWPS-10' is named identically and independently by MEED (verified page contains 'EWPS-8', 'EWPS-10', '480', '56') and BlackRidge Research (Package 8 = 'EWGP-3 and EWGP-4 from EWPS-8 to EWPS-10 (480 km)', contractor Larsen & Toubro). The route is in active construction: Pipeline Technology Journal (2025-09-10) reports L&T completed a 120 km 56-inch stretch of MGS Package 8. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION (HIGH): correctly recorded as a gas transmission trunk (large-diameter 56-inch east-west transport line), not a gathering/process/feeder line. FuelSource Gas correct. ATTRIBUTION (HIGH): Owner Aramco 100% correct (MGS is Aramco's own system). Endpoints EWPS-8 -> EWPS-10 (East-West Pipeline pump stations), both in Saudi Arabia. DUPLICATE CHECK: P6728 (roster: same 190 km / 56 in, EWPS-8-EWPS-10 '4') is the parallel companion line 'four' of the same Package 8 corridor - two physically distinct parallel pipes (line 3 and line 4), a legitimate two-row model, NOT a double-count/duplicate. DIAMETER 56 in corroborated by MEED and BlackRidge. StartYear1 2028 matches the Q4 2028 program completion target (BlackRidge). Length is flagged separately.

validity.researcher_notes: LENGTH (MEDIUM, material discrepancy). The sheet's own cited MEED source states: 'Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-8 to EWPS-10, covering 480km.' BlackRidge independently confirms Package 8 = 'EWGP-3 and EWGP-4 from EWPS-8 to EWPS-10 (480 km)'. GEM recorded P6727 (line 3) = 190 km and P6728 (line 4) = 190 km (380 km combined). Every OTHER EWPS pair in the cluster halves its MEED package figure exactly onto its two parallel lines: Pkg3 56km->P6717/18 = 28+28; Pkg4 300km->P6719/20 = 150+150; Pkg5 166km->P6721/22 = 83+83; Pkg6 370km->P6723/24 = 185+185; Pkg7 340km->P6725/26 = 170+170. P6727/P6728 BREAK that pattern: a halved Package 8 would be 240 km/line, not 190 km - so besides the shared halving question (each parallel line physically spans the full inter-station route, so under a route-distance reading each line should be ~480 km, per the sibling analysis on P6719/P6720), the 190 km figure is a further ~50 km/line short of even GEM's own halving convention (240). Total for the pair is 380 km vs the sourced 480 km - a 100 km shortfall. No source states 190 km for anything on this route; the origin of 190 is unclear (possible misread/transposition of the 480 package figure). I flag rather than overwrite: the clean fix is the cluster-wide EWPS length review the sibling rows already recommend, treating Package 8 as 480 km. Do NOT silently pass.
